**CASTING CALL – STUDENT SHORT FILM**

Both union and non union welcome!

SHOOT DATES: October 2,3,4 – 2026

SHOOT LOCATION: TBD

COMPENSATION: Non-Paid, $10/day for lunch for those on set for longer than 6 hours.

 

**Submission Instructions**

Please send a self tape to [foreverandalwaysfilm2026@gmail.com](mailto:foreverandalwaysfilm2026@gmail.com) – Due September 5th, 2026

 

**Trigger Warning:** This is a fictional story about a school shooting told from the perspective of two siblings. The film emphasises their emotional journey and survival, with no graphic depictions of the perpetrator or explicit violence. The subject matter may still be distressing to some viewers. Viewer discretion is advised.

 

**Synopsis**

After a heated argument at school, teenage siblings Annie and Thomas part ways just before a school shooting throws the campus into lockdown. Desperate to protect her younger brother, Annie risks everything to find him. The events have Annie prioritizing her brother’s safety, which ultimately leads to her death.

 

**Annie**

**Age                       Gender**

17-23                    Female

 

**Description**

Annie is in her last year of high school, 17 turning 18. For as long as she can remember, she always been an older sister. Sometimes It’s a joy, getting to tease and take care of her older brother. Other times it’s a nightmare, needing to share a bathroom and boss him into the kid he should be. Regardless, she loves her brother with everything she has. Annie goes through her life seemingly unafraid, internalizing her doubts and fears and facing them head on. As the eldest daughters, Annie is very good at taking care of herself. She forges her own path and puts up with her parents’ rules just as long as she needs to. Despite the grittiness of life, she chooses to look for the positives and focus on them rather than dwelling on the unwanted.

 

**Thomas**

**Age                    Gender**

15-20                 Male

 

**Description**

Thomas is in his first year of high school, turning 15 just before school starts. He’s never not had an older sister, and though he wouldn’t admit it to her face, she’s one of his biggest role models and best friend. He hates when she gets bossy and intrudes on his manly independence, but he feels a loss whenever they have a big fight and would rather put up with her. Thomas is bullied in school, by the same group of kids. He gets in his head and thinks they have more control over his life than they actually do, impacting his social life. Going through the formative years of his life, Thomas is still figuring out who he is. He likes to run and he likes Lego, but he doesn’t yet know who he’s meant to be.

 

**Mom**

**Age                           Gender**

35-48                         Female

 

**Description**

Mom cares deeply for her children, sometimes a little too concerned for their wellbeing. She’s not a helicopter parent- she believes in fostering a healthy level of independence, but she still has rules for their own sake. She wants to lift her children up as much as possible. For the last twenty years, she’s been working her way up in a media management company. Earning enough for their family to be comfortable and happy.

 

**Dad**

**Age                      Gender**

35-50                   Male

** **

**Description**

Dad loves the kids, especially when they do as they’re told. He always wanted to be a dad, mainly for the purposes of making dad jokes and getting eye rolls. The kids are his pride and jo. He works at a videogame company which gives him and his family related benefits such as discounted games and access passes. Though, the dad plays videogames the most of their family.

 

**Shooter**

**Age                 Gender**

17-23               Male

 

**Description**

The shooter is a student in their senior year, someone who’s not recognized in any sense of the word by his peers. Often not showing up to class, never participating in extra-curriculars, and never showing up to any kind of school events.

 

**Additional Characters**

**Students (15-18) (Background)** - Average teenage kids just trying to get through each and every day of the grueling high school experience. Some being apart of friend groups, large or small; some being loners.

**Office Workers/Teachers (30's-50's) (Background)** - Kind and helpful front office workers who are simply trying to make the school a welcoming, wholesome, and inclusive space.

*COMPANY RESEARCH: CASTING CALL*
ROSMERSHOLM by Henrik Ibsen (A new 90 min adaptation)

Synopsis: A year after his wife’s suicide, former clergyman Johannes Rosmer lives quietly at his ancestral home with Rebecca West, his late wife’s former companion. As Rosmer prepares to publicly reject his conservative past, buried truths about Rebecca, his marriage, and his wife’s death begin to surface. A psychological drama about love, guilt, idealism, and what haunts us in the consequences of our desires. 

Breakdowns:

Rebecca West (30s) - Independent, intelligent, charismatic and fiercely self possessed. An outsider who has become Rosmer’s closest confidante. Progressive and unsentimental, but carrying secrets about her arrival at Rosmersholm and her relationship with Rosmer’s late wife.

Mrs. Helseth (30s-50s) - Housekeeper at Rosmersholm and keeper of its traditions, and secrets. Practical, observant, superstitious, and deeply embedded in the history of the house. She sees more than she says. 

Peter Mortensgaard (30s) - Editor of the local radical newspaper and rising political force. Disgraced and exiled by the elite, shrewd, composed, and difficult to intimidate. Less interested in ideological purity than in how power really works. 

Ulrik Brendel (30s-50s) - Rosmer’s former tutor. An eccentric, impoverished intellectual, and once great idealist. Brilliant, theatrical, funny, and increasingly tragic. Grand in manner (or drunk) and uncompromising in his beliefs. 

Adapted and Directed by Alexander Steele Zonjic

Rehearsals and Production will take place in Mount Pleasant.

Rehearsals begin Sept 15th.

Show Dates: Nov 5-8, Nov 12-15 (with possible extension Nov 19-22)

Compensation: Profit Share - net profits from production will be shared among participating artists. 

Please submit through our google form: https://forms.gle/FK93PMNjed3ec8aEA

Submission deadline Sept 7th.

Selected applicants will be invited to audition in person in Mount Pleasant. Sides will be provided via email in advance.

🎥 In diesem Reel spricht Mag. Günther Wildner über die Anforderungen an einen Text, an ein Buch. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 175. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 22.09.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Die Vertrauensstelle vera* 
🎙️ Heidi Fuchs 
🎤 Moderation: Andreas Huber 

Wie können Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur verhindert werden? Welche Herausforderungen bringt die Präventionsarbeit mit sich – und welche Chancen eröffnet sie für nachhaltige gesellschaftliche Veränderung? 

Heidi Fuchs gibt Einblick in die Arbeit von vera*, der Vertrauensstelle gegen Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur. Sie berichtet von Erfahrungen, Herausforderungen und Chancen der Präventionsarbeit – mit besonderem Fokus auf die Schnittstellen zwischen Kunst, Kultur und gesellschaftlicher Veränderung. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die mehr über wirksame Prävention, sichere Arbeitsbedingungen und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang miteinander im Kunst- und Kulturbereich erfahren möchten. 

© Philipp Wagner 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/bfEYTvFfZ

Poesie und Wandern: Neue Gedichttafeln für Payerbach

Am Samstag, den 5. September 2026, wird um 13 Uhr im Rahmen des traditionellen Jakobi-Marktes beim Pavillon der neue „Poesiewanderweg“ seiner Bestimmung übergeben. An drei Standorten entlang des Bahnwanderweges zwischen Bahnhof Payerbach und Küb (Bahnhofsvorplatz, Kurpark, Küber Weg) wurden Schautafeln mit stimmigen Gedichten des lokalen Dichters und Künstlers Walter Baco aufgestellt. Die Stationen laden Wanderer, Passanten und Spaziergänger zum Verweilen und Nachdenken ein. Herzlicher Dank für die Umsetzung dieser Idee gilt dem Fremdenverkehrsverein Payerbach unter Obmann Heinz Hübner.

WARSZTATY STORYTELLINGOWE NA MOKOTOWIE!
Cztery lata temu leżałam w szpitalu. Pod sterydową kroplówką. Rozsadzało mi serce. I głowę. Mierzyłam się z wybuchem bomby. Stwardnienie Rozsiane. Koniec życia. Koniec sprawności. Okazało się, że był to początek. Sprawczości. Życia. Świadomości. Radości. Lekkości. Bomba rozwaliła cały mój świat. I bardzo dobrze zrobiła. 

Musiałam się nauczyć żyć na nowo. Inaczej. Zaczęłam słuchać ciała. Czyli siebie samej. Przestałam udawać. Grać. Zawodowo. I prywatnie. Zaczęłam stawiać granice. Zawodowo. I prywatnie. Znalazłam siebie samą. Uszanowałam siebie samą. Doceniłam. Zadbałam. 

Ta podróż od bycia, samo - przekraczającą się i przekraczaną, aktorką; od samookłamywania się i uciszania wewnętrznego głosu, do bycia MNĄ.... zaowocowała powstaniem Czuła Fundacja i Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie 

Tak też powstały moje autorskie Warsztaty Storytellingowe. Zebrałam wszystkie swoje doświadczenia zawodowe - aktorskie, reżyserskie i dramatopisarskie. Zebrałam wszystkie swoje doświadczenia życiowe. I stworzyłam przestrzeń do bycia ze sobą i przy sobie. Do szukania siebie. Do tworzenia.

Uczę prostych umiejetnosci warsztatowych. Jak mówić. Jak zaprzyjaźnić się z tremą. Jak pisać. Jak opowiadać. 

Uczę też metod relaksacyjnych i wyobrażeniowych, ktore mi samej pomagają na codzień. W życiu. I w pracy dramatopisarskiej.

Oddychamy. Rozmawiamy. Zagłębiamy się. Na tyle, na ile każdy jest gotowy. 

Jesteśmy. Wspieramy się. Opowiadamy. 

Wymiana doświadczeń i opowieści to bardzo elementarna, ludzka potrzeba. 

Dołącz do grupy, pogadajmy, pobądźmy!

Spotykamy się w piątki między 17.30 a 19.00. W FORMA Ośrodek Kultury 

Więcej informacji znajdziesz na stronie internetowej Czułej Fundacji i na mediach społecznościowych Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Możesz też do nas napisać: czulafundacja@czulafundacja.pl 

Dołączajcie do grupy! Nie mogę się Was doczekać!

A na zdjęciu relaksuję się w hamaku.

items.text:
OPEN CASTING FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM
Hello! My name is Tyasia Raynae and I am producing a student short film here in Orlando FL 

and we are currently casting for actors. We are also looking for extras.

This is a non-paid, non-union job, it is a student short film. Meals will be provided on set.

Expected filming the 1st or 2nd week of October 2026. The main cast, below on flyer, will need to have open availability all three days.

Kellen has been casted, so we are looking for Jason and Rose.

We are taking self-tape submissions at the email address on the flyer and/or to donttrpproductionsllc@gmail.com.

Email me with any questions you may have! 

Tyasia Raynae

Producer | Missing Peace

attachments.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'CASTING CALL Non-Paid Union Missing Peace The night before studio session an immature band breaks up and up to Kellen to bring them back together the next morning. Rose: Female, Any Ethnicity, A delicate singer and guitarist who is always there for everyone herself. Also looking for 10 extras Any Ethnecity Jason: Male, 20's, Any Ethnicity, Expected Filming A selfish singer and bass who can't stand being alone. October Virtual submissions only to No music experience is needed but preferred'

items.text:
**WARSZAWA**

**6 i 9 września**

**Stawki od 120 zł -220 zł gotówką**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego szukam statystów**:**

** **

**6 WRZEŚNIA (niedziela):**

**- MĘŻCZYZNA W TYPIE TIROWCA – **myje ręce w toalecie. 1 scena na 5:50. Stawka **150 zł gotówką**

**- KLIENCI STACJI BEZNZYNOWEJ Z AUTEM – **wiek bez znaczenia. Bez białych aut.** **Stawka** 180 zł gotówką. **Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

**- POLICJANCI MUNDUROWI **– mężczyźni 20-50 lat. Stawka **130 zł gotówką**

**- KLIENCI SKLEPU OSIEDLOWEGO – **kobiety i mężczyźni, wiek bez znaczenia.** **Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

 

**9 WRZEŚNIA (środa):**

- **WOLONTARIUSZE FUNDACJI** – młodzi ludzie 18-35 lat, chętnie alternatywni. Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

- **ROBOTNICY / PRACOWNICY WARSZTATU** – mężczyźni 18-60 lat. Stawka** 120 zł gotówką**

- **STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI** – stawka** 170 zł gotówką**.  Bez białych aut . Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

**- PRZECHODNIE –** **plan nocny do ok. 1:00 w nocy.  **Stawka** 180 zł gotówką**

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI - plan nocny do ok. 1:00 w nocy.  **Stawka **220 zł gotówką**. Bez białych aut. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 6** lub** KB 9**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

items.text:
🎬 Calling all filmmakers, writers, directors, actors, and storytellers!
If you're looking for a welcoming community of creative people, I highly recommend checking out Storyteller Sessions on Discord.

It's more than just a place to network—it's a friendly, supportive community where you can meet other creatives, make genuine friendships, collaborate on projects, and grow together. Whether you're just starting out or already working in the industry, everyone is welcome.

We regularly host live Zoom table reads, where you can submit your own scripts and hear them performed by talented actors while receiving valuable feedback. We also host special events featuring professionals currently working in the film and television industry who share their experiences and insights.

If you don't already have Discord, don't worry—it's completely free to create an account and join the community.

If you're passionate about storytelling and want to connect with other creatives, we'd love to have you!

🎬 Calling all filmmakers, writers, directors, actors, and storytellers!
If you're looking for a welcoming community of creative people, I highly recommend checking out Storyteller Sessions on Discord.

It's more than just a place to network—it's a friendly, supportive community where you can meet other creatives, make genuine friendships, collaborate on projects, and grow together. Whether you're just starting out or already working in the industry, everyone is welcome.

We regularly host live Zoom table reads, where you can submit your own scripts and hear them performed by talented actors while receiving valuable feedback. We also host special events featuring professionals currently working in the film and television industry who share their experiences and insights.

If you don't already have Discord, don't worry—it's completely free to create an account and join the community.

If you're passionate about storytelling and want to connect with other creatives, we'd love to have you!

Join Storyteller Sessions here: https://discord.gg/6E6cb8NaU

I hope to see you all there!

items.text:
Project: DAS NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)
Format: Short Film / Music Video
Tone: Atmospheric Dark Folklore / Gothic Metal Thriller
Language Requirement: German & English (Must speak both fluently)
Shoot Location: Marburg, Germany (Preference given to locals)
Union Status: Non-Union
Pay: 200 € per 8-hour day

LOGLINE & SYNOPSIS
Logline: When the alluring music of the Night Folk claims her impulsive lover, a grounded teen in 1860s Germany must face the phantom call before it sweeps away her remaining family.
Synopsis: In 1860s Germany, a fiercely practical girl mourns her reckless lover after he succumbs to the hypnotic melodies of the Night Folk. But as the solemn phantom march winds through the timeless streets of Old Marburg and lays claim to her own family, a haunting, transcendent choice awaits her in the shadows.

CASTING SPECS:

1860s GRANDFATHER – Male. 60-70. German. Talented, determined, yet ailing. While once fun and
jovial, he is now a physically frail widower raising his teenage granddaughter. He struggles to navigate a
rapidly changing world, deeply frustrated that his traditional, hard-earned wisdom is being brushed aside
by a restless new generation. A gifted musician no longer able to play. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND
ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days between October 28th-31st, tentatively 29th and 31st

1860s GIRL – Female. 14-16. German. Sharp-witted, fiercely practical, and grounded. While she
possesses a deeply passionate soul, she approaches life with logic, caution, and a mature sense of
responsibility. She takes excellent care of her ailing grandfather, even if she is the source of his
frustration and concern. Fiery but devoted, she’s a lovable spirit trying to carve her own path in trying
times. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 3 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th, 29th, and 31st

1860s BOY – Male. 16-18. German. Fiercely driven, cunning, but loyal. A bit rebellious and careless at
times, he lives entirely in the moment and is easily carried away by the raw emotion of a situation. He is
an idealist who acts first and thinks later, constantly ignoring societal constraints. A magnetic personality
who refuses to conform, he is a reckless visionary. MUST SPEAK GERMAN AND ENGLISH FLUENTLY.
Works 2 days, between October 28th-31st, tentatively 28th and 29th 

Send your photo, resume and reel to ganna@intheweehours.com 
Subject:  NACHTVOLK (THE NIGHT FOLK)

Hello lovelies! Runway Coach Luise here 😊 London Fashion Week is just around the corner, so now is the perfect time to sharpen your runway skills. 

London Model Academy is running an intensive 3.5 hour runway workshop with runway model and coach Luise Hasse (myself) this Sunday, 6th September, from 11:15am to 2:45pm in Fulham, London.

The session will focus on runway walking, posture, stride, body balance, arm movement, posing, confidence and expression, with practical coaching to help you feel more prepared for castings and the runway.

Suitable for aspiring and working models looking to build confidence and refine their technique ahead of Fashion Week.

Places are limited. For more information or to book, contact Michaela at Michaela@LondonModelAcademy.co.uk

More information: londonmodelacademy.co.uk/group-runway-workshop

🎬 **CASTING CALL – YOUNG MALE ACTORS PLAYING AGE 16–19 **

The Paul Lavelle Foundation & Big Egg Films are casting for ‘Healthy Doesn’t Hurt’, a powerful youth short film exploring healthy and unhealthy relationships, abuse, consent, misogyny and misandry.

We are looking for:

•            Young men to portray gay male main character roles

•            Young men for a range of supporting roles

We particularly welcome LGBTQ+ applicants, although nobody will be expected to disclose their sexuality.  Actors applying for the gay male roles simply need to feel comfortable portraying the characters and relationships respectfully.

No professional acting experience is essential confidence, reliability and natural acting ability are most important.

**Compensation:** Showreel, exposure, travel expenses & refreshments

📍 Filming in Wirral/Liverpool Merseyside

🎥 Filming: Must be available the week of 26th – 30th October 26.

🔒 Parent or guardian consent will be required for under 18s.

For more information or to apply, please send an email to request our self-tape audition pack to 

**casting@paullavellefoundation.co.uk**

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, deinem Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 36/2026

ZWEI FLÜCHTIGE IM SOMMERCAMP, ALARM IN DER WIESE UND DIE BERGIDYLLE WIRD ZUM ALBTRAUM

Das gewisse Etwas ist ein Remake des frz Film Un p'tit truc en plus. Ob die Version Made in Germany tatsächlich ein Wohlfühlmovie ist oder ob man doch beim Original bleiben soll, erfahren Sie bei uns.

Die beiden tollpatschigen Ameisensoldaten Arnie und Barney erlangten ursprünglich als beliebte Nebencharaktere in den „Die Biene Maja“-Kinofilmen Kultstatus. Nun bekommen sie in dem von Studio 100 International produzierten Spin-off ihr erstes eigenes, 75-minütiges Kinoabenteuer. Wie witzig oder doch steril das ganze ist, erzählt Ihnen Sarah Fuchs.

Wenn der Urlaub in den österreichischen Alpen zur Konfliktlösung dient, darüber erzählt Regisseur Mike van Diem in einem Interview über seinen neuesten Film OUR GIRLS und unsere Moderatorin besuchte die musikalische Filmreise im Schloss Kirchstetten und fand mit Stefan Gartner einen kompetenten Gesprächspartner.

Musikalisch gedenken wir den kürzlich verstorbenen Tim Curry.

Mittwoch 2.9.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Fotocredit Tim Curry © IMAGO/Everett Collection

Hey everyone! I’m a Casting Producer for Property Brothers and casting is now OPEN for homeowners with home renovation dreams in Vancouver! 

We’re looking for:

• Homeowners who have recently purchased a home

• A minimum renovation budget of $75K

• At least 3 rooms in need of renovation

• Availability for filming beginning in early Fall 2026 & into 2027

If your new home is full of potential and you’re ready for a transformation, we’d love to hear from you.

topComments.text: “All budget tiers!” Proceeds to say the minimum is 75 thousand dollars 🤣

Do you ever feature disability specific home Reno’s? 

Homeowners can claim up to $10k in a calendar/tax year for Reno’s designed to improve accessibility and safety for people with disabilities. If the timing is just right ($10k paid in fall, $10k paid in the new year) homeowners could access $20k in tax credits, and then kick in the rest of the money for superficial / cosmetic upgrades. 

It would be really cool to see families of people with disabilities being visible on a home show & it’s possible that the Property Brothers could partner with charities all over B.C. if they wanted to donate “over and above” for a family in need who didn’t have the extra funds (due to the vast majority of primary caregivers for children with disabilities being unable to hold full time employment) 

It’s a thought. I’d definitely watch—sadly our $10k for the year is already spent.

CASTING CALL

TITLE: The Haunted Studio

GENRE: Drama/Comedy

LOGLINE: 5 actors recieve mysterious invitations to an audition at an abandoned TV studio. At the studio they encounter hauntings and campy horror.

ROLES:

George – a young man, quietly confident

Hadley – a young woman, plays it cool level

Mags – a young woman, friendly and a little sloppy

Liam – a young man, pretty cool guy who turns out to be a bit of a scaredy-cat

Justin – a young man, a bit of a bully

Producer – 40s/50s, a practiced shopping channel show runner

PA - A young, people-pleasing production assistant who presents the cursed box

Runner - A young bike messenger

Ghost - The intimidating ghost that haunts the studio

PRODUCTION COMPANY: Denver Community Media. We are Denver’s community media access program and set up productions for students to get hands-on experience.

WRITER/DIRECTOR: Austin Anderson

PRODUCTION TYPE: Student Short Film

CONCTACT: Austin.Anderson@denvergov.org

RUN TIME: ~10 minutes

COMPENSATION: Unpaid

UNION STATUS: Non-Union

AUDITION INFORMATION: Self Tape or in-person at Denver Community Media

SHOOT DATES: Sept. 12th from 11am - 5:00pm and Sept. 17th and 18th from 5pm - 9pm. Some roles are needed for 1 day, some for all 3.

 

Cheers!

🔥 MONOCICLO JIRAFA EXTREMO — 4 METROS DE ALTURA 🔥

El artista que aparece en escena soy yo, Wilfredo Mauricio Triana Villalón, creador de Mundo Circense SXE, fabricante y usuario de este monociclo, con más de 30 años de experiencia construyendo, probando y utilizando profesionalmente este tipo de aparatos.

Una herramienta creada para artistas que desean llevar su espectáculo a otro nivel y conquistar la pista con una presencia imponente, elegante y profesional.

Puede fabricarse con sistema de doble cadena, aunque recomendamos una sola cadena por ofrecer un funcionamiento más directo y eficiente.

Su diseño busca proporcionar estabilidad, comodidad y seguridad durante la ejecución. Por tratarse de un aparato de gran altura, recomendamos utilizar cinturón de seguridad, revisar cuidadosamente el monociclo antes de cada presentación y mantener protegida el área de actuación. La seguridad del artista y del público siempre debe formar parte del espectáculo.

🛠️ Fabricación profesional y personalizada.
🎪 Diseñado y probado por un artista de circo.
📏 Altura: 4 metros.
🏆 Más de 30 años de experiencia.

No fabricamos juguetes; fabricamos herramientas de trabajo para profesionales.

🌎 Mundo Circense SXE
Diseño y fabricación de aparatos circenses.

Twój biznes podupada? Nie wiesz, co dalej?

Szukamy kobiet, które prowadzą własny biznes, ale znalazły się pod ścianą.

Klientów jest coraz mniej. Pieniędzy zaczyna brakować. Motywacja spada. A Ty nie masz już pomysłu, jak to odwrócić.

Jeśli jesteś w takim momencie — chcemy poznać Twoją historię.

Szukamy kobiet, które są gotowe zawalczyć o swój biznes i siebie. W programie TVN Style „Babski biznes” z pomocą doświadczonych ekspertek spróbujemy znaleźć rozwiązania, nowy kierunek i sposób na nowy start.

Twój biznes może być w kryzysie. Ty nie musisz się poddać.

 Zgłoś się w wiadomości prywatnej  i opowiedz nam swoją historię.

🎬 CASTING CALL

007 CASTING AGENCY is currently seeking MALE TALENT, 18–25 YEARS for two featured film roles.

SIYA

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A charismatic, sharp-tongued and high-energy young man with natural confidence and street-smart charm. Quick-thinking, funny and unpredictable, Siya has a strong presence but also a more caring and vulnerable side beneath his tough exterior.

We’re looking for:
• Strong personality and screen presence
• Natural charisma and confidence
• Good comedic timing
• Ability to handle emotional and confrontational scenes
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability

BONGI

Male | 18–25 | XHOSA-SPEAKING

A warm, gentle and likeable young man with a bigger physical presence and a natural sense of rhythm. Affectionate, creative and eager to please, Bongi requires an actor who can bring both humour and emotional depth to the role.

We’re looking for:
• Warm and natural personality
• Good comedic and emotional range
• Natural sense of rhythm / dancing ability
• Strong isiXhosa speaking ability
• Ability to portray vulnerability and emotional conflict

🎥 AUDITION PROCESS

Selected applicants will receive audition sides and self-tape instructions.

Acting experience is welcome, but strong natural performers with the right presence and ability are encouraged to apply.

CASTING REQUIREMENTS

👤 Male
🎂 18–25 years
🗣️ IsiXhosa-speaking
🎭 Strong screen presence and performance ability

📩 TO APPLY

Please send your:

• Full name
• Age
• Location
• Contact number
• Recent headshot/photo

📧 info@007castingagency.co.za
📱 069 221 5294

Subject: SIYA / BONGI CASTING

Please apply only if you meet the specified requirements.

007 CASTING AGENCY
Talent • Casting • Production Support

Cześć! Szukamy mężczyzn w wieku (18-30)do udziału w naszym filmie krótkometrażowym, realizowanym w ramach niezależnej produkcji studenckiej.

Poszukujemy osób do ról statystów oraz bohaterów epizodycznych, wcielających się w grupę młodych ludzi o „patologicznym” / ulicznym charakterze. Zależy nam na osobach, które naturalnie pasują do takiego wizerunku — doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane.

🎥 Film krótkometrażowy
🎓 Projekt studencki, niezależny, non-profit
📍 Poznań
📅 Zdjęcia: 3–4 października
🎭 Statyści / role epizodyczne

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany, napisz na:

📩 email.od.filmow@gmail.com

W zgłoszeniu podeślij kilka słów o sobie oraz aktualne zdjęcie. Jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą lub materiały aktorskie, również możesz je dołączyć.

Masz znajomych, którzy pasują do opisu? Podeślij im ogłoszenie! 🎬

# 🏠 **CASTING SAISON 1 – QUI HABITE ICI ?**

Tu vis dans un **lieu atypique**, surprenant ou complètement hors du commun ?

Péniche, château, tiny house, loft, ancienne école, maison insolite… Nous recherchons des candidats partout en France pour participer à la Saison 1 de notre prochain gros concept Youtube : **Qui Habite Ici ?**

Nous recherchons :

• Des personnes vivant dans un logement atypique

• Personnalités atypiques 18 à 88 ans

• Solo, couple, famille, colocataires, tout est permis…

Si ton lieu de vie ne ressemble à aucun autre et que tu as envie de tenter une expérience unique, inscris-toi dès maintenant !

📅 Tournage : 26 septembre 2026 - Journée entière

🔗 Lien d’inscription : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScfqR04e4js8I52NWi5a496OTeb4zg3A2DbJkcEyrOkZVMaFw/viewform?usp=publish-editor

sharedPost.text:
"كنا نشتري الملابس لا لغاية الستر، بل للظهور.
نضحك في الحفلات ونبكي في المراحيض.
نحن عبيد للدوبامين."

🎥 هذا هو عالم "ريجيم" .. فيلم قصير يبحث عن هويته البصرية من خلال عيون طاقم متطوع.

نبحث عن أشخاص يحبون السينما، ويؤمنون بأن الفيلم الجيد يصنع بأيدٍ متحمسة قبل أن يصنع بميزانية.

---

**مطلوب:**

🎞️ مساعد مخرج
📷 مدير تصوير
🎬 مونتير
🎧 مهندس صوت
💡 إضاءة
🎨 ديكور وأزياء
🧑‍🎤 ممثلين/ممثلات

---

📆 التصوير خلال الأسبوع القادم (تاريخ مرن)
📍 الدار البيضاء

💬 للتواصل: رسالة خاصة على الصفحة

🌟 العمل تطوعي .. لكن الفيلم سيكون لنا جميعاً، وسيحمل أسماءنا في نهايته.

شارك المنشور .. كلمة قد تغير كل شيء.

When self-serving charmer Rick returns home late, his lying puts him at the mercy of his fixated wife Lucy, whose razor inches closer to his throat as she reveals she knows the truth.

SEEKING: TWO LEADS

Male Actor — Late 20s/Early 30s - Clean-shaven / willing to shave

Female Actor — Mid-to-Late 20s

SHOOT: TBC — Early November

LOCATION: Brixton, London

PAY: EXPENSES ONLY

See attached casting sheets for further character information.

If interested, please contact caseyreeseevans2003@yahoo.com with a headshot and any supporting materials.

Otherwise, please comment with a Spotlight link or DM if required.

👀🔥 LONDON! NEW BLACK QUEER THEATRE INCOMING…
Hey everyone! Hope it’s okay to share this here ❤️

My new play PEEPHOLE is having its FIRST REHEARSED READING at BRIXTON HOUSE this Monday 7th September at 8:15PM, and I’d love to get as many of you in the room as possible!

“Kem is da ultimate roadman.�Icon is the ultimate diva.�Can love that came alive between Brixton Prison sheets hope to survive on Brixton streets?” 👀

PEEPHOLE is a wild romantic dramedy following two Black queer men whose relationship begins inside Brixton Prison and then has to face the reality of surviving on the outside.

It’s Black. It’s queer. It’s raw, funny, messy, romantic, sexy and a likkle bit WILD. 😂🔥

✍🏾 Written by Dior Clarke�🎬 Directed by Rikki Beadle-Blair�🎭 Dior Clarke as ICON�🎭 King Georges as KEM�🎥 Produced by Loquaciously Unfiltered

📍 Brixton House, London�📅 Monday 7th September�⏰ 8:15PM�🎟️ Tickets from just £8

https://brixtonhouse.co.uk/book-online/320057/

This is the first ever rehearsed reading of the play, so come be one of the first people to experience Icon and Kem’s story.

If you love Black stories, queer stories, new writing, theatre, romance, comedy, drama or just some good fucking storytelling, COME THROUGH! ❤️

And if you can’t make it, sharing this with someone who can would mean the world.

🎟️ BOOK HERE:�https://www.therendition.co.uk/whats-on/peephole

See you in Brixton! 👀🔥

🎬 CASTING CALL – FEMALE LEAD ROLE | SHORT FILM

I’m looking to cast the lead role of Emily in my upcoming short film Good Grief, which I’ve written and am directing.

This is my first short film project, and it’s a passion project that I’m putting a lot of time, care and attention into. The rest of the cast is already in place, the locations and props are sorted, and we’re now just looking for the right actress to bring Emily to life.

🎭 ROLE: EMILY

Female | Mid-20s (22 to 26) White/Caucasian 

Emily is sensitive, warm, introspective and deeply emotional. This is a lead role and the character carries much of the film, so I’m looking for someone who can really nail the emotional scenes and bring a genuine, natural performance rather than simply delivering lines.

There are some particularly emotional moments in the film, so emotional range and the ability to convey grief, love and vulnerability naturally are really important.

🎥 THE FILM

Good Grief is an intimate, cinematic short film exploring love, grief, memory and the softness we carry after losing someone we love.

The film is being made with film festival submissions in mind, and I’m passionate about creating something visually beautiful and emotionally meaningful.

📍 Location: Haworth, West Yorkshire
📅 Filming: September 2026 — exact date to be confirmed
⏱️ Duration: Approx. 10–15 minutes
💷 Payment: Unpaid — this is my first independent short film and is being made as a passion project. All production elements, props and the rest of the cast are already organised.

I completely appreciate that unpaid work isn’t for everyone, but if you’re an actress who is passionate about acting and would love to be part of a small, ambitious short film, I’d love to hear from you. If however there is an actor who has a lot of experience already I could try to find a way to pay a fee. 

📩 TO APPLY

Please DM me with:

• Headshot
• Showreel / previous acting work (if available)
• Spotlight link (if applicable)
• Location
• Availability in September

I’ll send Emily’s dialogue / casting tape material to anyone interested in auditioning.

Please feel free to share or tag any actresses who you think could be right for the role.

Thank you! 🎬

Looking at these pictures reminds me of something important…

I’m not done becoming the man I’m supposed to be.

Every version of me has a story. The confident me. The serious me. The businessman. The creator. The actor. The father and grandfather. And the man who still wakes up believing there’s another level to reach.

Age doesn’t stop dreams. Your past doesn’t cancel your future. And starting over doesn’t mean you failed—it means you had the courage to keep going.

I’m building, creating, learning, and chasing opportunities I once only dreamed about.

This is Adan Santiago—still under construction. 💯

The goal isn’t just success. The goal is LEGACY.

Which picture should become my new profile photo—1 through 9? 👇🔥

#AdanSantiago #Legacy #NeverGiveUp #ActorLife #Entrepreneur #ContentCreator #SecondChances #KeepBuilding

**🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

🎤 ZGŁOSZENIA TRWAJĄ! Każdy głos zasługuje na własne światło! 🌟

Czy Twój wokal jest gotowy, aby wybrzmieć w całej Polsce? 🎶

Wystartowała rekrutacja do Ogólnopolskiego Konkursu Piosenki On-Line „Scena dla Wszystkich 2026”! To Twoja wyjątkowa szansa, by stanąć na naszej wirtualnej scenie, zaprezentować swój talent, zdobyć wartościowy feedback od profesjonalnego Jury oraz powalczyć o fantastyczne nagrody i uznanie publiczności!

Dlaczego warto do nas dołączyć?

🏠 Pełna wygoda (Formuła On-Line): Nagrywasz utwór w domowym zaciszu, w studiu lub na próbie i wysyłasz zgłoszenie bez konieczności podróżowania!

🏆 Profesjonalne Jury & Nagrody: Twoje wykonanie oceną eksperci z branży muzycznej, dając Ci szansę na zdobycie cennych wyróżnień.

🗳️ Głosowanie Publiczności: Oprócz ocen jurorów walczysz o wsparcie i serca swoich fanów w specjalnym głosowaniu!

✨ Dla Każdego: Nieważne, ile masz lat i jaki styl muzyczny reprezentujesz. Nasza scena jest otwarta dla każdego wokalisty.

Nie zwlekaj! Wybierz swoją ulubioną piosenkę, przygotuj nagranie i wejdź do gry już dziś! 🚀

Halo Wrocław!!

AGENCJA AKTORSKA POSZUKUJE: 

mężczyzn statystów z Wrocławia do serialu fabularnego, 
osadzonego w Polsce w latach 90!

Miejsce zdjęć: Wrocław.

Terminy: 8.09.2026-11.09.2026

Plan zdjęciowy trwa do 12 godzin. 

Wymagana jest dostępność przez cały dzień!

Ze względu na historyczne miejsce akcji w latach 90 wymagane jest: 
brak widocznych współczesnych tatuaży na dłoniach i szyi,

AKTOR/SZUKAM PROJEKTÓW
Hej! Mam na imię Dominik Kusajda, mam 18 lat i szukam możliwości udziału w filmach, serialach, reklamach, teledyskach oraz innych produkcjach.

🎭 Od października rozpoczynam naukę w studium aktorskim i intensywnie rozwijam się w kierunku aktorstwa. Mam doświadczenie przed kamerą, m.in.:

• „Uroczysko” – epizod

• „Policjanci i Policjantki” – epizod

• „Trudne Sprawy” – rola drugoplanowa

• „Sprawiedliwi – Trójmiasto”

Przez 4 lata aktywnie interesowałem się również modelingiem i brałem udział m.in. w „Top Model”.

Dodatkowo umiem strzelać z łuku, co może być przydatną umiejętnością przy odpowiednich rolach i produkcjach.

Jestem otwarty na różnego rodzaju role i produkcje. Zależy mi przede wszystkim na zdobywaniu doświadczenia, pracy na planie i rozwijaniu się jako aktor

CASTING CALL: MOM, 40s
Axis is casting a woman in her 40s for a short, cinematic Advent video filming in Centennial, Colorado.

The character is a relatable, overwhelmed mom trying to keep up with the chaos of Christmas. We are looking for an actor with strong comedic instincts who can also bring warmth, subtlety, and emotional honesty to the role.
Filming date: September 17
Time: 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.
Location: Centennial, Colorado
Pay: $500
To submit, please email the following to [Irene@axis.org](mailto:Irene@axis.org) by September 9:

- Self-tape using the attached audition side
- Current headshot
- Acting resume
- Reel, if available
Please use the subject line: “Advent Light Audition – [Your Name]”
Include your phone number and confirmation that you are available for the full filming window. This role includes both on-camera performance and voiceover.

**Title**: **IS THAT YOU, GOD?**

**Genre**: *Horror*

**Logline**: When young Anastasia confides in God ... He speaks back. Though, she soon realizes there is no escape from the restrictions of religion.

Roles:

**ANASTASIA** - *LEAD* - *Female, 8-15*

Quiet, but curious. Naive and sweet. She's always trying to find comfort within the religion her mother forces upon her.

**MOTHER** - *SUPPORTING* - *Female, 40-60*

Strict and snappy. An incredibly catholic woman who *will* make her daughter a follower as well.

**"GOD"** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 30-55*

A voice that Anastasia believes to be the one, true God speaking back to her. Determined, he will stop at nothing to get Anastasia. 

**FATHER MICHAEL** - *SUPPORTING - Male, 40+*

A kind and professional priest, trying to help Anastasia take the correct first steps in her faith.

**Director**: Lizzie Kleewein

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**: 

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

THIS WEEKEND

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 1pm-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "IS THAT YOU, GOD? - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will provide sides to send in a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 23-26th, and 28th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to religious trauma.

Musical theatre needs personality.

Commit to the movement. Commit to the character. Commit to the ridiculous jazz hands. 😂

Learn it. Drill it. Then GO FOR IT.

🎬 CASTING CALL | THE AVENUE
Baltimore, this one is for YOU. 🏙️

I’m currently casting for “The Avenue,” an independent Baltimore-based short film rooted in culture, humor, community, and the everyday realities of city life.

items.text:
** Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

**Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,**

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Aktuell bin ich auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie neuen Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse**. Besonders interessiere ich mich für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme und weitere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte meine Erfahrungen vor der Kamera kontinuierlich erweitern, mich weiterentwickeln und weitere Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche gewinnen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits **als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude bereitet und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig regelmäßig vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig**. Gleichzeitig bin ich offen für unterschiedliche Rollen und Aufgaben und freue mich darauf, mich auf neue Projekte und Herausforderungen einzulassen.

Ich stehe sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** zur Verfügung. Anfragen aus **Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet** sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich sehr über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme. Gerne sende ich Ihnen **aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** zu.

Ich freue mich darauf, interessante Projekte kennenzulernen, weitere Erfahrungen zu sammeln und neue Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche zu knüpfen.

**Mit freundlichen Grüßen**

**Nicolay Bein**
🎬 Schauspieler | Kleindarsteller | Komparse
📍 Hamburg

📱 **Mobil:** 0176 4192 1114

Hey everyone, thought I’d introduce myself! 

My name is Alanna, I am currently 17 almost 18 in January. I am deaf with cochlear implants to help me hear! I am based in Derbyshire currently. 

I’ve been a dancer ever since I could walk and never have stopped! I sign BSL (British sign language) and I can speak English too. I also do modelling for fun. 

I am currently in college doing performing arts, I do dancing,singing and acting. I have performed at Lichfield Garrick theatre with my college. I’ve performed with level 2’s and level 3’s while I was on level 1! I did 2 shows with them, one back in November 2025 and one back in May 2026. In May we did “The Merry Wives of Vegas”, my tutor switched most parts from “The Merry Wives of Windsor” into our own piece. My tutors wanted me to sign to one of the song that we was performing with and I was happy to do that and so we did! (It made everyone cry!)  I signed to “Both Sides Now” by Joni Mitchell. I did acting, singing (background only) and dancing 💃! 

My dreams are to perform on the stage whether that’s dancing, acting, modelling or being an idol, I just wanted to get myself out there more often so any recommendations would be much appreciated! 

Thank you so much everyone!!

My modelling account: https://www.instagram.com/alanna_models?igsi=OWp6anB5cjRkdTRk&utm_source=qr

My official account: https://www.instagram.com/alanna_official1?igsi=NGNoNXp2Z3kxZnV0&utm_source=qr

CCUK NEWS

Colin Firth, Julianne Moore, Laura Linney and David Tennant filming The Joy of Sex in London

Another major British feature film is currently shooting in the UK, bringing together an extraordinary cast including Colin Firth, Julianne Moore, Laura Linney and David Tennant.

The Joy of Sex is currently filming in London and tells the remarkable true story behind one of the most influential books of the 1970s.

Oscar winner Colin Firth stars as British scientist and author Alex Comfort, whose groundbreaking book The Joy of Sex became an international phenomenon following its publication in 1972.

The book sold more than 15 million copies worldwide and spent 70 weeks at the top of The New York Times bestseller list.

But behind the publishing sensation was a complicated and unconventional personal story, and that's the story the new film will explore.

THE STORY BEHIND THE BOOK

The film centres on Comfort, his wife Ruth and her best friend Jane.

Comfort believed that a more open and joyful attitude towards sexuality could help create a more peaceful society.

His ideas became intertwined with his own increasingly unconventional private life, as a relationship developed between Comfort and Jane alongside his marriage to Ruth.

That complicated love triangle ultimately became part of the inspiration behind the book that would change the way millions of people talked about sex, relationships and intimacy.

Colin Firth plays Alex Comfort, with Laura Linney portraying Ruth and Julianne Moore playing Jane.

AN INCREDIBLE CAST

The three leads are joined by another group of major British and international performers.

David Tennant, Jason Watkins and Vicky Krieps are also appearing in the film.

That gives The Joy of Sex one of the most recognisable casts of any feature currently filming in Britain.

BRIDGET JONES DIRECTOR BEHIND THE CAMERA

The film is directed by Sharon Maguire, whose credits include Bridget Jones's Diary and Bridget Jones's Baby.

Maguire also co-writes the screenplay with Lise Mayer.

Director of Photography is David Higgs, while production design is credited to Lucienne Suren and Jos Richard.

FILMING IN LONDON

Production began in the UK in July 2026 and The Joy of Sex remains listed among productions currently filming in London.

For the British screen industry, productions like this are significant beyond the household names appearing on screen.

Feature films shooting in London support a much wider production workforce across locations, costume, hair and make-up, art departments, construction, camera, lighting, transport, supporting artists and numerous other areas of the industry.

WHO'S PRODUCING THE FILM?

The Joy of Sex is being produced by Monumental Films, Seven Stories Film & TV and Kinescope Pictures.

Producers include Alison Owen and Debra Hayward for Monumental Films, Anand Tucker for Seven Stories Film & TV and Matthias Greving for Kinescope Pictures.

The film also has an extensive group of executive producers.

Embankment Films is handling global sales, while Lionsgate will distribute the film in the UK.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

🎬 Title: The Joy of Sex

🎥 Production: Feature film

🎭 Genre: Comedy / drama / romance

🇬🇧 Production status: In production

📍 Filming: London, UK

🎬 Director: Sharon Maguire

✍️ Writers: Sharon Maguire and Lise Mayer

📷 Director of Photography: David Higgs

🎨 Production Design: Lucienne Suren and Jos Richard

🏢 Production Companies: Monumental Films, Seven Stories Film & TV and Kinescope Pictures

🌍 International Sales: Embankment Films

🇬🇧 UK Distributor: Lionsgate

📅 Expected: 2027

🎭 Casting Director: Not publicly confirmed in the production information checked

CAST

Colin Firth – Alex Comfort

Julianne Moore – Jane

Laura Linney – Ruth

David Tennant

Jason Watkins

Vicky Krieps

ANOTHER MAJOR PRODUCTION FILMING IN BRITAIN

With Colin Firth, Julianne Moore, Laura Linney and David Tennant leading the cast, The Joy of Sex is another substantial international feature currently being produced in the UK.

It's also another example of the volume and variety of productions currently passing through Britain's studios, locations and production infrastructure.

Casting Calls UK has not announced or received an official casting call connected with The Joy of Sex.

Actors and supporting artists should only respond to legitimate opportunities issued through recognised casting professionals, agencies or verified production sources.

We'll continue following The Joy of Sex as production progresses for further verified casting, filming and release updates.

Każdy talent zasługuje na swoją chwilę, a każda twórcza pasja — na możliwość zaprezentowania jej światu. To doskonały moment, aby zrobić kolejny artystyczny krok, spróbować swoich sił i zdobyć nowe osiągnięcie! 🎨🎶💃🎭

Zapraszamy do udziału w IV Międzynarodowym Dwuturowym Konkursie Sztuki „JASKRAWI I UTALENTOWANI” — wydarzeniu otwartym dla dzieci, młodzieży i dorosłych, którzy kochają sztukę, rozwijają swoje umiejętności i chcą podzielić się swoim talentem. 🌟

📅 Przyjmowanie zgłoszeń: od 03.09 do 16.09.

💻 Konkurs odbywa się w formule zdalnej, dzięki czemu możesz wziąć w nim udział z dowolnego miejsca — wygodnie, bez podróży i bez ograniczeń geograficznych. 🌍

🌟 Bez ograniczeń wiekowych
🎤 Wszystkie nominacje i gatunki
📜 Dyplomy dla uczestników
💐 Listy podziękowania
🏅 Medale
🏆 Puchary

🔴 Wyjątkowy koszt uczestnictwa — tylko 35 PLN! 🔴

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScBsIJSoPzOd0VwuypEcdUsC8696iWsI51BasBEsNJrEm3Adw/viewform

Nie odkładaj swojego talentu na później! ❤️ Każdy występ, każda praca i każda artystyczna idea mogą stać się początkiem kolejnego sukcesu.

Udział w konkursie to nie tylko możliwość zdobycia dyplomu czy nagrody. To również nowe doświadczenie, motywacja do dalszego rozwoju, kolejny punkt w artystycznym portfolio i piękne potwierdzenie własnych możliwości. ✨

🎬 KOMPARSEN GESUCHT | WESTERN-DREH | 11.–13.09.2026 | EBERSBERG

Hallo zusammen,

für meinen Bachelor-Film „Grave Stakes“ suche ich im Raum Ebersberg bei München noch Kompars:innen für unseren Western-Dreh.

🤠 12. & 13. September 2026:
Jeweils 6 Kompars:innen pro Tag.

Western-Kleidung ist gerne gesehen, aber keine Pflicht. Ein schlichtes Hemd oder möglichst Western-like Kleidung reicht völlig aus. Westernhüte werden vor Ort zur Verfügung gestellt.

🎬 Freitag, 11. September 2026:
Hier suche ich einen Mann und eine Frau, die ein Ehepaar spielen und gemeinsam kurz durch das Bild laufen.

Bei Interesse oder Fragen meldet euch gerne direkt bei mir:

📞 0162 8235913

Drehort: Raum Ebersberg bei München

Vielen Dank!
Paul Dächert

Hallo zusammen!
Ich bin professionelle Artistin und aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen Engagements und Castings in Deutschland und Europa.

Meine Schwerpunkte sind Seiltanz / Balance-Acts, Bühne, Show und Performance. Ich bin Guinness World Record Holder und habe internationale Bühnenerfahrung, u. a. bei Britain’s Got Talent, TV-Produktionen, Varieté, Zirkus und internationalen Shows.

Ich freue mich über Kontakte zu Agenturen, Produzenten, Veranstaltern und Casting Directors sowie über Hinweise auf aktuelle Castings und Engagements.

Wohnort: Bayern | deutschlandweit & international verfügbar.
Portfolio, Videos und weitere Informationen sende ich gerne per PN.

Vielen Dank!
Oksana Seroshtan

💢CASTING CALL 💢
Its that time again....

Auditions (self tapes) are now open for 'Benji jnr' and "Benji's mum". 

The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces. 

The film is the second film of Tori Hughes, who's first film 'The Aftermath' is an award winning film and currently doing the festival circuit. 

See slides for roles, dates and details.

Please be aware that roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing and so this may change given budget. Film will be entered into the festival circuit and is built to raise awareness of themes involved. 

Please message myself, Claire Ward  or Sarah Elizabeth  if you wish to self tape. We look forward to watching! 

.

.

.

.

#shortfilmmaking  #fundraising  #RaisingAwareness  #casting  #castingcallsuk

topComments.text: Hi, Ive sent you a DM Tori West 👍👌🎬
Any sa,s needed please I have experience BBC few times ch4 ch5 lfc and other projects thanks Richard Alexander o brien

attachments.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'The CyeKc- CyeKue Casting call The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces into adult life. Includes scenes of violence and addiction. Filming will take place in or around Stoke on Trent- November 2026. Roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing. Get in touch via message if you would like to self tape.'

May be an image of text that says 'The Ciol Cye- Casting Call- Benji 5 mum- 40-50 This role will encompass playing mum to our lead Benji at 2 different stages of Benji's life, both as a child and a young adult. Benji's mum struggles with alcohol addiction and substance misuse which creates a role reversal of care from Benji towards mum, however a deep connection is shown therefore good chemistry with the lead is important. Benjis mum needs to be able to show a deep vulnerabilty alongside a 'lost' but caring nature.'

May be an image of text that says 'The Cy- Cyele Casting Call- Benji Benjijnr-7-10 jnr- 7-10 Benji jnr will play the younger version of our lead Benji. Benji jnr will portray a difficult childhood and therefore will need to be able to show a range of emotions from upset to fear and affection.'

items.text:
**CASTING CALL — Do you have a loved one in the UK? **

We're making a short documentary-style film about the food we miss when the people we love are far from home. We're not looking for actors. We're looking for a real family, Black/ Coloured/ Indian. Must be available for shoot dates in Early October

You might be right for this if:
* You have a grown child, sibling or parent living in the **United Kingdom (Including Ireland/ Scottland/ Whales)**
* You know what their life over there actually looks like — the work, the hours, the city
* There's a dish only you make properly, the one they always ask for. Bobotie. Melktert. Koeksisters. Umngqusho. Breyani. Your trifle, the one the family still argues about.
* You'd be comfortable being yourself on camera

**One important thing: this is a surprise.** Please don't mention it to your person in the UK — not a call, not a message, not a hint. If they find out, we can't use the story.

We're casting a South African family of colour (Black, Coloured or Indian). The selected family is professionally remunerated, and everything you send us is treated as confidential.

**Interested?** WhatsApp me a **voicenote or a short video** telling me:
1. Who your person is, and where they are in the UK
2. **What they do over there, and how long they've been there**
3. The dish they miss most — and why only you can make it right

📲 **0834563341 - This must reach me no later than 8 September**

I'll send you the full brief and a short questionnaire from there.

*Please share this with someone it might fit — just not with the person in the UK.*

items.text:
👀🔥 LONDON! NEW BLACK QUEER THEATRE INCOMING…
Hey everyone! Hope it’s okay to share this here ❤️

My new play PEEPHOLE is having its FIRST REHEARSED READING at BRIXTON HOUSE this Monday 7th September at 8:15PM, and I’d love to get as many of you in the room as possible!

“Kem is da ultimate roadman.�Icon is the ultimate diva.�Can love that came alive between Brixton Prison sheets hope to survive on Brixton streets?” 👀

PEEPHOLE is a wild romantic dramedy following two Black queer men whose relationship begins inside Brixton Prison and then has to face the reality of surviving on the outside.

It’s Black. It’s queer. It’s raw, funny, messy, romantic, sexy and a likkle bit WILD. 😂🔥

✍🏾 Written by Dior Clarke�🎬 Directed by Rikki Beadle-Blair�🎭 Dior Clarke as ICON�🎭 King Georges as KEM�🎥 Produced by Loquaciously Unfiltered

📍 Brixton House, London�📅 Monday 7th September�⏰ 8:15PM�🎟️ Tickets from just £8

https://brixtonhouse.co.uk/book-online/320057/

This is the first ever rehearsed reading of the play, so come be one of the first people to experience Icon and Kem’s story.

If you love Black stories, queer stories, new writing, theatre, romance, comedy, drama or just some good fucking storytelling, COME THROUGH! ❤️

And if you can’t make it, sharing this with someone who can would mean the world.

🎟️ BOOK HERE:�https://www.therendition.co.uk/whats-on/peephole

See you in Brixton! 👀🔥

items.text:
🎭 BIENVENUE CHEZ CORPS À VIF ! ✨

L’adolescence est une période charnière : les premières grandes questions, les premiers enjeux de la vie, les doutes, les changements, les relations aux autres et à soi commencent à prendre une place importante.

C’est aussi une période où il est essentiel de pouvoir trouver un espace pour s’exprimer librement, se libérer, prendre confiance et être écouté.

🎭 Dans nos cours, nous défendons des valeurs essentielles :
✨ La bienveillance
🤝 Le respect de chacun et de chaque singularité
💛 La construction et la reconstruction de soi
🌈 La good vibe et le plaisir de créer ensemble
🫶 Un cadre sain, sécurisant et exigeant

Parce que oui : nous voulons que les ados se sentent bien… tout en pratiquant le théâtre sérieusement.

Au programme : une approche plurielle pour découvrir et développer toutes les dimensions de l’artiste 🎭

🕺 Des notions de danse et de mouvement pour éveiller le corps et travailler la posture
📚 Le travail des textes à la table, pour comprendre, analyser et interpréter
🎬 Des exercices de technique théâtrale
🎤 Le développement de l’expression scénique
🧠 Un travail autour des émotions, de l’imaginaire et de la psychologie des personnages
✨ Et surtout : apprendre à prendre sa place, à écouter, à créer et à oser.

Et ce projet me tient particulièrement à cœur.

Ayant moi-même été victime de harcèlement scolaire, et ayant mené plusieurs campagnes de sensibilisation sur ce sujet, je sais combien il est important de pouvoir trouver un endroit où l’on se sent accepté, respecté et libre d’être soi-même.

Je souhaite que ce cours puisse être, pour chaque adolescent, un espace de confiance, de partage et parfois même un refuge. Un endroit où l’art peut s’exprimer, où chacun peut trouver sa voix, sa place et sa lumière. ✨

🎭 COURS THÉÂTRE ADOS
📅 Tous les mercredis
🕔 17h — 19h

🇬🇧🎭 COURS THÉÂTRE ADOS EN ANGLAIS
📅 Tous les jeudis
🕕 18h — 20h

Ici, on travaille.
Ici, on apprend.
Ici, on ose.
Ici, on crée.
Et surtout… ici, chacun a le droit d’être soi. 💛

Bienvenue dans cette nouvelle aventure. 🎭✨

#TheatreAdos #CoursDeTheatre #TheatreEnAnglais #TeenTheatre #ConfianceEnSoi #ExpressionDeSoi #Bienveillance #ArtEtCulture #Theatre #Adolescence #ExpressionScenique #GoodVibesOnly #HarcelementScolaire #ArtCommeRefuge #GrandirEnsemble

Ayant moi-même été victime de harcèlement scolaire, et ayant mené plusieurs campagnes de sensibilisation sur ce sujet, je sais combien il est important de pouvoir trouver un endroit où l’on se sent accepté, respecté et libre d’être soi-même.

Je souhaite que ce cours puisse être, pour chaque adolescent, un espace de confiance, de partage et parfois même un refuge. Un endroit où l’art peut s’exprimer, où chacun peut trouver sa voix, sa place et sa lumière. ✨

🎭 COURS THÉÂTRE ADOS
📅 Tous les mercredis
🕔 17h — 19h

🇬🇧🎭 COURS THÉÂTRE ADOS EN ANGLAIS
📅 Tous les jeudis
🕕 18h — 20h

Ici, on travaille.
Ici, on apprend.
Ici, on ose.
Ici, on crée.
Et surtout… ici, chacun a le droit d’être soi. 💛

Bienvenue dans cette nouvelle aventure. 🎭✨

**Title: ACTS OF MERCY**

**Genre: ***Drama*

**Logline: **Following the death of her mother, a veterinarian faces addiction and guilt as she tries to evade grief.

**Roles:**

**MAGNOLIA **- *LEAD - Female, 20-35*

Magnolia is no stranger to death, running an in-home animal hospital, yet refuses to grieve the death of her mother. She faces guilt, addiction, and drug induced hallucinations, but continually tries to bury her feelings.

**MARIE **- *SUPPORTING - Female, 40-60*

Marie is eccentric, confident in her decisions, and unafraid to grieve. She knows that euthanizing her cat will prevent it from suffering longer, but that doesn't lessen the impact of loss. She feels no embarrassment when expressing her grief.

**Director**: Evangeline Buchenberger

**Production Type**: Short Film

**Contact Information**: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

**Run Time**: Short

**Compensation**: Unpaid. Snacks provided, meals, credit, and copy of final film.

**Union Status**: Non-Union

**Audition Information**:

**IN-PERSON AUDITIONS** at CCA's Cinematic Arts Open Auditions, 9075 E Lowry Blvd. Denver, CO 80230.

Friday, September 4th, 10AM-5pm and Saturday, September 5th 10am-4pm.

**SELF TAPE AUDITIONS**: please send an email to sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com with the subject line "ACTS OF MERCY CASTING - YOUR NAME". Please also include a recent headshot, resume, and demo reel, if available, and we will send you sides to send in as a self tape.

**Shooting Schedule**: October 14th, 16-19th.

**Filming Location**: Denver area

**Project Notes**: Please note that this project contains references to drug use, self harm, and euthanasia.

CASTING CALL:
Title: Sugarwater
Genre: Sci-fi/horror, student short film
Logline: Two construction workers uncover a strange creature in the dirt.

Characters:

Cam (M, 20s-30s, LEAD): 
An enamored construction worker with his head in the clouds.

Riley (M, 20s-30s, LEAD):
A sensible worker just trying to get through the day.

TV Woman (F, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
An old-Hollywood starlet radiating glamor.

TV Man (M, 20s-30s, SUPPORTING):
A classic noir antihero with a tendency to break hearts.

Shooting will take place over 4 days in November for Cam and Riley, and one day in October for the TV Woman and TV Man, all in or around the Denver, CO area. Compensation will be meals, gas compensation, credit, and a copy of the final film. The final film will be exhibited at CU Denver's Cinefest in May 2027 and will then be submitted to other film festivals for further distribution.

Use this link or scan the QR code in the flyer below to access to audition form: https://forms.gle/v9PMj5nAh4wV7fpA8

If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at caitlin.lebakken@cuanschutz.edu. Thank you!

items.text:
Most self tapes never get watched all the way through. The ones that do get stopped in the first ten seconds.

And almost never because of the acting.

I've sent hundreds of these as an actor and sat watching thousands of them as a producer. What kills a tape is nearly always small, technical and fixable in five minutes. Where your reader is standing. What your camera is sitting on. Whether the sound is clean.

New lesson is up — ten of them, all taken from the Casting Directors Guild's own guidance rather than my opinion.

attachments.ocrText: May be an image of text that says 'BOOK THE JOB Put your reader in the right place 1. 2. Sound beats lighting 3. Light from the front 4. Medium close-up, camera at cye level 5. Never tape into silence 6. Read the brief ten times 7. Hold the scene at both ends 8. Two takes maximum, and make them different 9. Suggest the role, don't dress for it 10. You have rights'

items.text:
I’m trying to help cast teens (ages 12–17) for a b-roll shoot for Edgeline Films' upcoming documentary, The Anxious Generation, exploring how phones and social media have changed childhood and adolescence. The film will premiere on a streamer next year! 

The Details: 

Filming: Sunday, Sept 13th, 10am–6pm in south slope, Brooklyn. We only need a one or two hour window — happy to work around your teen's schedule.

What we're shooting: Stylized, cinematic shots of teens on phones -- scrolling through social media, macro shots of eyes as they scroll, hands swiping, and other candid glimpses of everyday life growing up with smartphones. 

No acting or speaking experience needed — just teens who are open to being on camera (and hanging out on a fun set!). 

If you know anyone who might be open to participating, please have them fill out this form 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf-KU_Mw_Ca8I4EHJzzh9NnEHxOb2lKP-SfIbkUdWrBR6uqTA/viewform

and our producer Sophie will reach out

🎬 CASTING CALL – VANCOUVER (PAID)
URGENT / LAST-MINUTE CASTING

I’m looking for ONE ACTOR for a small part in a short independent film, *Cordoba*, shooting in East Vancouver ONE DAY ONLY: September 11.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MIRANDA TREASE — Female, 40s

An intelligent, capable city planner. Busy, practical and perceptive—and also a mother and wife. A character-driven domestic story.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SHOOT

📍 Vancouver
📅 September 11, 2026 — 1 day
At least one brief in-person rehearsal beforehand.

PAY

$250 stipend + meals

UNION OR NON-UNION ACTORS WELCOME.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE OPPORTUNITY

A small, focused and collaborative production. The finished film will be submitted to festivals, and professional-quality footage will be available for your reel.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TO APPLY

Please send a headshot and short bio. Reel/clips welcome but not required.

Because the shoot is coming up quickly, please get in touch as soon as possible.

CASTING UPDATE: This notice will be removed as soon as the role is filled.

CONTACT

Kegan Doyle
[Kegan.doyle@kpu.ca](mailto:Kegan.doyle@kpu.ca)
